title: Count pending samples beyond the first 25
test_file_status: planned new file in existing tests/voice lane

evidence.observed: A mock server with 30 pending records honoring the requested limit returns 25; only one request is made and the voice command announces '25 pending samples'.

user_impact: The spoken pending workload understates the backlog whenever it exceeds the default page size.
implementation_scope: Make get_pending_samples retrieve the full pending collection using the supported SENAITE pagination contract. Keep generic search defaults and exact-target lookup behavior intact. Reject incomplete or repeating pagination rather than returning a falsely complete list.
acceptance: A 30-record paginated fixture returns all 30 distinct records.
Cover empty, one-page and multi-page results, repeated cursors/pages and a later-page error.
Assert the supported request pagination parameters in fixtures; do not assume increasing a fixed limit solves pagination.
constraints: Change only the named source file and test file for implementation.
All verification uses synthetic fixtures and mocks; no live SENAITE writes or email.
Do not run jobs sharing a source file as concurrent writers.
